targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.driver_name AS "Driver", SUM(f.points) AS "Points"
FROM fact_race_results f
JOIN dim_driver d ON f.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN dim_race r ON f.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.season_year = ${season} AND f.driver_id IN (${driver})
GROUP BY d.driver_name
ORDER BY "Points" DESC;

SELECT d.driver_name AS "Driver", SUM(f.positions_gained) AS "Net Positions Gained"
FROM fact_race_results f
JOIN dim_driver d ON f.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN dim_race r ON f.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.season_year = ${season} AND f.driver_id IN (${driver})
GROUP BY d.driver_name
ORDER BY "Net Positions Gained" DESC;

panels.title: ⏱️ Sector Times (S1, S2, S3) & Speed Trap Analysis
Sector Splits & Top Speed by Driver

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.driver_code AS "Driver",
  d.driver_name AS "Full Name",
  ROUND(MIN(flt.sector1_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS "Best S1 (s)",
  ROUND(MIN(flt.sector2_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS "Best S2 (s)",
  ROUND(MIN(flt.sector3_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS "Best S3 (s)",
  ROUND(MIN(flt.lap_time_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS "Best Lap (s)",
  MAX(flt.speed_trap_kmh) AS "Speed Trap (km/h)",
  COUNT(flt.lap_id) AS "Laps Completed"
FROM fact_lap_times flt
JOIN dim_driver d ON flt.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN dim_race r ON flt.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.season_year = ${season} AND flt.race_id = ${race} AND flt.driver_id IN (${driver})
GROUP BY d.driver_code, d.driver_name
ORDER BY "Best Lap (s)" ASC;
